status: experimental interoperability architecture; no production promotion
purpose: Allow local, intermittently connected, institutional-private, or air-gapped deployments to carry the exact verifier context needed to check bounded assertions without treating offline availability as permission to extend stale trust.
core_invariants: portable verification context is not portable authority
offline availability does not extend expiry
cached trust material does not imply current external revocation state
reconnection triggers explicit reconciliation where required
high-consequence decisions may require a fresh revocation/currentness check even if the proof itself verifies
bundle provenance and verifier reproducibility are separately inspectable
air-gapped verification must state which external facts cannot be refreshed
nonclaims: A portable bundle does not make an offline assertion current forever.
A valid bundle does not grant execution authority.
A bundle does not prove that an external issuer, chain, service, or institution remains uncompromised.
This profile does not prescribe a single packaging, signature, or cryptographic format.
